decisions.reason: The candidate already captures the same-message template reuse and location-specific customization; package and price consistency belongs to booking functionality and does not further change the template requirement.
Keeping packages and prices consistent across sites does not alter the requirement for separate location bookings, calendars, revenue, sales, payouts, or management control.
The candidate already captures the same-message branding customization; package and price consistency does not change the brand identity requirement.
Consistent packages and prices on location sites do not change the master site's role, location links, or location-selection navigation.
The source decision concerns cross-location package and price consistency, not the master site's design reference or layout characteristics.
